title: Sparkly kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5f6d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc371'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- kite string -->
  <path d='M50 72 Q46 85 44 96' stroke='#7fe7ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- kite body: diamond -->
  <polygon points='50,14 78,44 50,74 22,44' fill='url(#kiteGrad)' stroke='#ffe6b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- cross struts -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='50' y2='74' stroke='#ffe6b0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='44' x2='78' y2='44' stroke='#ffe6b0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- top quadrant accents -->
  <polygon points='50,14 64,29 50,44 36,29' fill='#ff3d6e' opacity='0.85'/>
  <polygon points='50,44 64,59 50,74 36,59' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- tail ribbon -->
  <path d='M50 74 Q56 80 50 84 Q44 88 50 92' stroke='#8affc1' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='92' r='2.6' fill='#8affc1'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff7a8'>
    <path d='M16 22 l1.6 4.4 4.4 1.6 -4.4 1.6 -1.6 4.4 -1.6 -4.4 -4.4 -1.6 4.4 -1.6z'/>
    <path d='M84 26 l1.4 3.8 3.8 1.4 -3.8 1.4 -1.4 3.8 -1.4 -3.8 -3.8 -1.4 3.8 -1.4z'/>
    <path d='M80 66 l1.4 3.8 3.8 1.4 -3.8 1.4 -1.4 3.8 -1.4 -3.8 -3.8 -1.4 3.8 -1.4z'/>
    <path d='M20 64 l1.2 3.3 3.3 1.2 -3.3 1.2 -1.2 3.3 -1.2 -3.3 -3.3 -1.2 3.3 -1.2z'/>
    <path d='M30 12 l1 2.8 2.8 1 -2.8 1 -1 2.8 -1 -2.8 -2.8 -1 2.8 -1z'/>
    <path d='M72 12 l1 2.8 2.8 1 -2.8 1 -1 2.8 -1 -2.8 -2.8 -1 2.8 -1z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#b8f0ff'>
    <circle cx='10' cy='44' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='50' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='84' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='88' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='86' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='82' r='1.2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
